metadata.windowRule: Trailing calendar years ending at the latest accepted observation
metadata.statistic: Arithmetic Mean from the 1 HOUR daily summary (not a daily maximum or AQI)
metadata.dateBasis: EPA Date Local: local standard time, midnight to midnight (PST, UTC-08)
metadata.eventPolicy: Keep None/No Events/Events Included; never event-excluded summaries
metadata.missingPolicy: Explicit nulls; no interpolation, zero substitution, monitor fallback, or extrapolation
metadata.negativeValuePolicy: Retain finite source-reported values; no clipping
metadata.interpretation: Total measured PM2.5 from all sources, not a source-specific wildfire-smoke measure. No health interpretation.
